name: daily-practice
description: Track daily progress in the Whole Life Challenge (WTC)

paragraphs: A personal health and habit tracker built with React, shaped around the Busy Dad Training philosophy: focus on the movement, not the number. Track daily practices, set weekly goals, and build streaks over time.
features: Morning Numbers: Each day proposes your numbers (burpees or navy seals, pull-ups) from your weekly goals — review, adjust one-offs, and accept them.

Flow Timer: A numbers-free 20-minute workout timer. A bell-strike pulse blooms once per rep with a warm chime (plus haptics) — no counters, no clocks, no overthinking. Audio-only milestones mark the halfway rep and the…

Session Recording (optional): record your workout for self-review with a mirrored live preview. Recordings auto-save to on-device storage with a list to replay, download, or delete — video never leaves the device. Works…
Daily Tracking: Habit checkboxes (workout, stretch, read + coffee), pull-ups with actual rep counts, and a hydration tally — organized time-neutrally, so the practice fits any hour of the day.

Clean Eating: tracked by exception — every day starts clean and costs zero taps; slips get logged against five trigger foods (Gluten, Dairy, Fried, Sweets, Alcohol). One free day per week forgives its slips. A separate…

whatItDoes.text: A personal health and habit tracker built with React, shaped around the Busy Dad Training philosophy: focus on the movement, not the number. Track daily practices, set weekly goals, and build streaks over time.

requirements.text: Firebase Auth & Firestore: Google sign-in (via Google Identity Services) with per-user cloud data, locked down by version-controlled security rules (firestore.rules).
